scope: All 24 core invocations only; independent local raw parsing and pooling, no frozen validator/summarizer invoked as proof. Full 60-job study remains incomplete.

methods.pooling: 100 untrimmed raw per-iteration rank-MAX CUPTI samples from each exact EP/communication/capacity/N/variant repeat; concatenate to 200 then median and convert ms to us. No median-of-medians or cross-group mixing.
methods.ratios: Split_us/Mega_us; signed change = 100*(Mega_us/Split_us - 1), negative means lower observed Mega latency. Summary JSON/CSV compared exactly using binary-float arithmetic.
methods.input_reference: Raw input_contract_passed and source-bound independent oracle checked. Source-backed A2A mapper checks BF16 hidden, full K8 IDs and FP32 weights against canonical source block, rejecting missing/duplicate/ambiguous rows. No input tensors/maps serialized: this local audit does not recompute expert outputs.
methods.source_reuse: Accepted full-gate/source/helper/environment and first A2A/AG evidence reused through identical SHA; every core raw log independently reparsed.

limitations: Only complete core phase: 24/60 jobs and 84/110 performance groups. Later autotuning/routing/prefill phases excluded.
Native cross-pair outcomes remain distinct; separate per-path oracle and same-backend graph PASS do not establish backend equality.
Two poisoned untimed graph replays are checked; numerical contents of 100 timed replays are not.
Samples are source-bound logged rank maxima. Individual rank arrays, input/mapping/output tensors are not serialized, preventing independent local rank-max or tensor recomputation.
Two repeats do not establish statistical significance. Direction reversals reported without causal explanation; no serving causality.
Shared compile caches and untimed setup/oracle history exist; no independent physical-sample claim.
